# Security

Security fixes target the latest release.

Report a vulnerability with
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/zalkilabs/zalki/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected version, the impact and a minimal reproduction. Do not
include credentials, session capabilities, message bodies or personal paths.

Zalki's capabilities stop sessions from mixing up identities by accident; they do
not protect against a hostile process that runs as the same OS user.
